author: Ari Koslow
title: Samad Taylor collects three hits Tuesday
desc: Samad Taylor went 3-for-4 in the Padres 7-6 win over the Braves on Tuesday.
impact: Taylor continued his strong stretch since joining the Padres at the start of June. He collected his third three hit performance in just 15 games with San Diego, now hitting .370 overall at the plate for the Padres.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Fernando Tatis Jr. goes deep Tuesday
desc: Fernando Tatis Jr. went 2-for-5 with a home run in the Padres 7-6 win over the Braves on Tuesday.
impact: Tatis hit an RBI double as part of a five-run second inning for San Diego. He later tied the game with a solo shot in the seventh inning. It is just his third long ball on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Griffin Canning does not make it out one inning Tuesday
desc: Griffin Canning allowed four runs on four hits over 2/3 an inning with two strikeouts and one walk on Tuesday against the Braves.
impact: Canning was pitching in a bulk relief role, but he did not make it out of one inning in a rough outing. He is currently scheduled to face the Cubs next.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cole Young hits go-ahead home run Tuesday
desc: Cole Young went 1-for-3 with a home run and two RBI in the Mariners 3-2 win over the Pirates on Tuesday.
impact: Young was playing in his first game back home where he grew up as a Pirates fan in Pittsburgh. He gave the Mariners the lead for good in the seventh inning with a two-run long ball in his first game back in Pittsburgh.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cal Raleigh hits home run Tuesday
desc: Cal Raleigh went 1-for-4 with a home run in the Mariners 3-2 win over the Pirates on Tuesday.
impact: Raleigh got the Mariners on the board with a solo shot in the fourth inning. It was his first long ball since being activated from the injured list and just his eighth home run on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Andres Munoz earns save Tuesday
desc: Andres Munoz struck out the side in a save on Tuesday against the Pirates.
impact: Munoz looked as good on Tuesday than in any of his recent appearances. He is up to 14 saves now on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: George Kirby earns win Tuesday
desc: George Kirby allowed two runs on eight hits over six innings with five strikeouts and two walks in a win on Tuesday against the Pirates.
impact: Kirby finished his outing strong after allowing a run in the second and third innings on seven hits through the first three frames. He'll take a 3.94 ERA into his next start against the Guardians.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Edward Cabrera (hamstring/adductor) to be placed on IL
desc: Cubs manager Craig Counsell told reporters Edward Cabrera is headed to the injured list.
impact: Cabrera was on crutches in the clubhouse and will undergo an MRI to determine the severity of the injury he suffered. He was carted off the field during Tuesday's start.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zack Gelof day-to-day with right hand laceration and contusion
desc: Zack Gelof is day-to-day with a right hand laceration and contusion.
impact: Gelof had X-rays return negative after he had his hand stepped on by Matt Chapman at second base during Tuesday's game. He is day-to-day going into Wednesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Francisco Lindor (calf) could be activated this week
desc: The Mets could activate Francisco Lindor from the injured list this week.
impact: Lindor finished 2-for-5 with two singles on Tuesday for Triple-A Syracuse in a rehab game. He played eight innings at shortstop. He is expected to re-join the Mets next where he'll be further evaluated.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Lodolo (wrist) has X-rays return negative
desc: Reds manager Terry Francona told reporters Nick Lodolo underwent X-rays that came back negative for any fractures.
impact: Lodolo was removed from Tuesday's start after he took a comebacker off his left wrist. He is day-to-day heading into the rest of the week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Patrick Sandoval (biceps) throws 53 pitches in rehab start Tuesday
desc: Patrick Sandoval threw 53 pitches over 3 1/3 innings on Tuesday in a rehab start for Triple-A Worcester.
impact: Sandoval allowed two runs with one strikeout and one walk. He'll continue to build-up his pitch count on his rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jack Flaherty (leg) throws 83 pitches in rehab start Tuesday
desc: Jack Flaherty threw 83 pitches over 5 2/3 innings on Tuesday in a rehab start for Double-A Erie.
impact: Flaherty allowed two runs with seven strikeouts and one walk in his first rehab start. He should be making his return around the corner back in the Tigers rotation.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Byron Buxton not expected to be traded by Twins
desc: Twins GM Jeremy Zoll said there are no plans to trade Byron Buxton.
impact: Buxton has a full no-trade clause and would need to approve any potential deal. The trade rumors will continue, but it appears he'll be remaining in Minnesota, at least for now.
